question: **Direction: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.**
solution:
The correct answer is "Marrige."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The incorrectly spelt word is 'Marrige.'
 
• The correct spelling word is **"marriage."**
 
• "Marriage" means the state of being husband and wife. (पति-पत्‍नी होने की स्थिति; विवाह, शादी)
 
 
• Example: *They had a long and happy **marriage**__.*
 
 
 
• The correct answer is Option 1.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] __Additional Information__

 
• Breakage: something that has been broken. (टूट-फूट)
 
• Wreckage: the broken pieces of something that has been destroyed. (मलबा, विनष्‍ट वस्‍तु के अवशेष)
 
• **Drainage: **a system used for making water, etc. flow away from a place. (पानी आदि के निकासी की प्रणाली)
